arrangement.notes: Arrangement follows a cinematic rise and fall of energy, designed for mainstream boom bap style with aggressive mood and modern sample chopping.

sample_layer.description: Modern sample chopping techniques applied across drum and melodic layers.

sound_intent.overall_character: Aggressive, punchy, cinematic dynamic flow with sharp sample chops.
sound_intent.tone: Warm vinyl texture with crisp transient emphasis on drums and cuts.

routing_intent.drums: Sample chops routed through transient shaper and parallel compression chains.
routing_intent.bass: Clean low-end with subtle saturation to complement drum punch.
routing_intent.chords: Processed with light reverb and EQ to blend with melody.
routing_intent.melody: Sample chops routed through delay and modulation FX for depth.
routing_intent.vocal: Minimal processing, focus on clarity and presence.
routing_intent.fx: Spatial effects automated to enhance section transitions.

track_roles.melody: main instrumental theme using modern chops

designer_intent.goal: Create a mainstream boom bap arrangement with aggressive energy and cinematic flow using sample chopping techniques to build rhythm and texture.

presetor_intent.goal: Apply presets that emphasize transients, vintage texture, and spatial effects consistent with boom bap style.

sensei_drum.brief: Design energetic drum parts with aggressive, punchy sample chops using modern slicing and stuttering techniques.

bass_generator.brief: Create a solid, warm bass foundation that supports drums and melody without overpowering.

harmony_generator.brief: Generate harmonic pads and chords using sampled instruments that blend well with the chopped melody.

melody_generator.brief: Produce melodic lines utilizing modern sample chopping techniques to add interest and variation.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure and energy dynamics ensuring cinematic rise and fall for mainstream appeal.

presetor.brief: Select and configure presets for each track focusing on vintage texture, transient shaping, and spatial effects.

songgps.brief: Track the arrangement energy curve and section transitions ensuring smooth dynamic flow and section clarity.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mix guidelines aiming for clarity, punch, and warm analog feel in the final audio deliverable.
